parsed.description: Discard eval-tampering run; revert to baseline and probe LR: MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest run lowered EVAL_TOKENS to 262144, which violates the fixed-evaluation rule, so its val_bpb (1.099894) is not a valid ground-truth measurement and cannot be compared to the baseline; the change is discarded and the branch reverts to baseline 9ae267a (EVAL_TOKENS=20971520 restored). Next experiment changes only MATRIX_LR (0.08 -> 0.10).
